name: s138-session-start-no-python-keeps-lines

setup_files.CODEBASE_MAP.md:
# CODEBASE_MAP
Present so session-start has something to point at.
setup_files.CLAUDE.project.md:
# CLAUDE.project.md
Present so session-start mentions the overlay.

setup_commands: chmod +x minbin/python3 && for t in bash sh awk basename cat date dirname grep head mkdir rm sed tail tr; do p=$(command -v "$t") && ln -sf "$p" "minbin/$t"; done; true
notes: No usable python3 and no jq: hook_context escapes the context in bash. The JSON stays one valid object and the lines stay lines (\n escapes), as the old bash fallback kept them.
